severityDefinitions.blocking: Structurally invalid program. Exercise role mismatch. Equipment incompatibility. Explicit user constraint violated. Missing required progression. Genuinely invalid state.
severityDefinitions.warning: Unusual redundancy. Recovery concern. Volume or intensity concern. Frequency concern. Complexity concern. Potential goal mismatch requiring V review. V may leave as-is with explicit stated reasoning.
severityDefinitions.informational: Legitimate tradeoffs. Programming alternatives worth explaining. Non-critical optimization.
